```{python}
#| fig-cap: "Expected ROI by Political Success Probability: Accounting for Implementation Risk"
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path

# Import centralized style

from dih_models.plotting.chart_style import (
    setup_chart_style, add_watermark, clean_spines,
    COLOR_BLACK, COLOR_WHITE, PATTERN_DIAGONAL, PATTERN_HORIZONTAL,
    add_png_metadata, get_figure_output_path)
from dih_models.parameters import format_parameter_value, TREATY_ROI_TRIAL_CAPACITY_PLUS_EFFICACY_LAG

setup_chart_style()

# Expected ROI = conditional ROI x political success probability.
# Ladder spans the POLITICAL_SUCCESS_PROBABILITY distribution: 0.1% lower bound,
# 1% central estimate, 10% upper bound (confidence_interval=(0.001, 0.10)).

base_roi = float(TREATY_ROI_TRIAL_CAPACITY_PLUS_EFFICACY_LAG)

probability_values = [0.001, 0.0025, 0.005, 0.01, 0.05, 0.10]
probability_labels = [
    '0.1%\n(Lower\nBound)',
    '0.25%\n(Very\nPessimistic)',
    '0.5%\n(Pessimistic)',
    '1%\n(Central)',
    '5%\n(Optimistic)',
    '10%\n(Upper\nBound)'
]
expected_rois = [base_roi * p for p in probability_values]

# Create figure

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14, 8))

# Create bars - use solid black for emphasis on the central case (1%)

bars = ax.bar(
    range(len(probability_labels)),
    expected_rois,
    color=[COLOR_WHITE, COLOR_WHITE, COLOR_WHITE, COLOR_BLACK, COLOR_WHITE, COLOR_WHITE],
    edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK,
    linewidth=2.5,
    width=0.7,
    hatch=[None, None, None, None, PATTERN_DIAGONAL, PATTERN_HORIZONTAL]
)

# Add value labels using centralized formatter.
# The 100x spread squashes the low-probability bars, so their labels are
# staggered upward in a staircase to keep adjacent boxes from colliding.

label_offsets = [0.03, 0.13, 0.23, 0.33, 0.04, 0.04]
for i, (bar, roi) in enumerate(zip(bars, expected_rois)):
    # format_parameter_value with unit="ratio" already appends ":1"
    label = format_parameter_value(roi, unit="ratio")
    ax.text(
        i, roi + max(expected_rois) * label_offsets[i],
        label,
        ha='center', va='bottom',
        fontsize=24, fontweight='bold',
        color=COLOR_BLACK,
        bbox=dict(
            boxstyle='round,pad=0.4',
            facecolor=COLOR_WHITE,
            edgecolor=COLOR_BLACK,
            linewidth=2
        )
    )

ax.set_ylim(0, max(expected_rois) * 1.28)

# Add probability labels below bars

ax.set_xticks(range(len(probability_labels)))
ax.set_xticklabels(probability_labels, fontsize=18)

# Remove y-axis (values are on bars)

ax.get_yaxis().set_visible(False)

# Set title

ax.set_title('Expected ROI by Political Success Probability', 
             fontsize=28, weight='bold', pad=30)

# Clean spines

clean_spines(ax, ['top', 'right', 'left'])

# Add watermark

add_watermark(fig)

# Save PNG

output_path = get_figure_output_path('expected-roi-political-probability-column-chart.png')
plt.savefig(output_path, dpi=200, bbox_inches=None, facecolor=COLOR_WHITE)
add_png_metadata(output_path,
                 title="Expected ROI by Political Success Probability",
                 description="Expected value analysis showing ROI accounting for implementation risk across different political success probabilities")

plt.show()
```
